_comment: Production VASP seed dataset. Every entry here is a REAL, publicly-documented address. This is a small, deliberately curated sample for prototype purposes, not a comprehensive VASP intelligence database — addresses are NOT added to inflate the count, because an unsourced address would weaken every conclusion drawn from this file. Never mix synthetic/demo addresses into this file — see data/seed/demo_known_vasps.json for those.
_provenance: `source_type` uses the taxonomy in app/attribution/models.py::SeedSourceType and states what the ownership claim actually rests on. 'community_label' means crowd-sourced explorer tagging (an investigative lead, NOT proof of ownership); 'official_disclosure' means the VASP itself published the address. Adding a new address is a pure JSON edit — no Python change is required.
